mechanism_narrative: The sustained and increasing trend in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a population-wide preference for staying home, directly reducing participation in retail and recreation activities, leading to a further decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining elevated.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week rebound in WORKPLACES mobility signals a return to office-based work, which will subsequently drive an increase in weekday retail and recreation footfall, leading to higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises by more than 10 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC continues to decline over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent and sustained increase in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility indicates a broad return to pre-pandemic commuting and out-of-home routines, which will collectively boost RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES show a sustained increase, but RETAIL_REC remains stagnant or declines over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains consistently above 15% of baseline, it indicates the continued enforcement or strong adherence to stay-at-home policies, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 15% of baseline, but RETAIL_REC shows a significant increase over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A continued week-on-week decline in PARKS mobility suggests a general increase in public caution and reduced willingness to engage in any non-essential outdoor activities, directly translating to a further immediate decline in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS declines by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: PARKS declines by more than 2 points week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC shows an immediate increase in the subsequent week.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM mobility stabilizes or slightly recovers while RETAIL_REC continues its downward trend, it signifies a shift towards essential-only outings, indicating that non-essential retail will continue to decline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility stabilizes or recovers, and RETAIL_REC also stabilizes or increases over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained low and declining TRANSIT mobility indicates a fundamental reduction in urban movement and commuting, directly correlating with reduced foot traffic and demand for retail and recreation, leading to a further decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility remains low or declines further, yet RETAIL_REC shows a significant upward trend over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility remains significantly below -25% of baseline and RESIDENTIAL mobility remains consistently above 10% of baseline, it indicates a strong and sustained work-from-home or stay-at-home policy environment, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility remains below -25% and RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 10%, but RETAIL_REC significantly increases over the next 28 days.
